results.question: Who's most at risk right now?
results.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[n:NEAR]->(x)
WHERE n.active = true
WITH t, collect({
    id: x.id,
    kind: x.kind,
    status: x.status,
    distance_m: n.distance_m,
    sources: n.sources,
    evidence_refs: n.evidence_refs
}) AS near
WITH t, near, 
     reduce(s = 0, r IN near |
           s + CASE 
                WHEN r.kind = 'hazard' AND r.status = 'active' THEN 50 
                WHEN r.kind = 'building' AND r.status = 'collapsed' THEN 30 
                WHEN r.kind = 'building' AND r.status = 'damaged' THEN 15 
                WHEN r.kind = 'facility' AND r.status = 'full' THEN 20 
                WHEN r.kind = 'facility' AND r.status = 'closed' THEN 10 
                ELSE 0 
              END) AS danger
WHERE danger > 0
RETURN t.id AS id, t.name AS name, t.status AS status, danger, near
ORDER BY danger DESC, t.status_since ASC
LIMIT 5
results.answer: Rescue Team 4 is on scene near an active gas hazard at 55.4 meters and a collapsed building at 20.9 meters, posing the highest immediate risk.
